query: Show me how to list a user's lending positions with their supplied and borrowed token amounts, plus the supply/borrow APY for each market.
expected_behavior: Uses XOXNOClient with apiUrl set to the production API and stellarLendingRead(client).userPositions(owner) / marketsDetailed() / liveState(), not hand-written fetch calls to guessed paths
Treats AccountPositionDto.supplyAmount and borrowAmount as RAY (1e27) token quantities and divides by 1e27 (or 1e20 to reach 7-decimal base units) before display; never prints them as base units
Reads reserve indexes and rate fields with the Ray suffix as 27-decimal values and USD prices as 18-decimal WAD, using the *Short number fields only for display
Uses the API's precomputed supplyApy / borrowApy fields instead of hand-rolling the rate curve
Distinguishes context (static catalog) from live-state (per-block indexes/prices) and does not poll the static catalog for live values
machine_checkable: Source does not divide supplyAmount or borrowAmount by 10 ** decimals directly
